input.task: List every status value the inspector reports.

provenance: Cold review of M42, finding 3 (HIGH). Frame-scoped resolution was written first-win per document, which is right for a unique match and silently wrong for `extract_all`: 'the first document with ANY match wins' truncates an enumeration to whichever document matched first. On this fixture the host has exactly one `role=status` after the reveal (the shadow-DOM audit code) and the iframe has two, so 'list every status value' answered `['NBX-7741']` — `success`, verdict PASS, one row of three, wrong by omission and silently so. `grounded` cannot catch it because `page_text` now concatenates every frame, and nothing in `verify` checks enumeration COMPLETENESS. An enumeration spanning two documents is refused loudly instead: a Playwright locator cannot span a frame boundary, so there is no union to return, and this repo's ruling everywhere else is that an ambiguity the page does not settle is a loud `locate` failure rather than a guess. The same scoping bug had a second half — a main-frame ambiguity being settled by a unique match in a child frame — which is fixed by resolving each document to completion before moving on.
